yacl3.config.adaptivetooltips:config.cat: This group of options modifies the content of the tooltip.
yacl3.config.adaptivetooltips:config.wra: How Adaptive Tooltips wraps tooltip text.
yacl3.config.adaptivetooltips:config.ove: Stop vanilla from applying its own text wrapping to tooltips in the GUI and use Adaptive Tooltips' instead.
yacl3.config.adaptivetooltips:config.cat: This group of options determines where the tooltip will appear on the screen.
yacl3.config.adaptivetooltips:config.pri: When the tooltip height is larger than the screen height, vanilla prioritizes fitting the bottom on the screen and cuts off the top. This option changes the priority to the top instead.
adaptivetooltips.opt.prioritize_tooltip_: Prevents vertical check for %s because the tooltip never goes above the screen.
yacl3.config.adaptivetooltips:config.bed: When the tooltip is too long to fit on the screen, it is centered on the mouse instead of being placed to the left or right.
yacl3.config.adaptivetooltips:config.bes: When all else fails (including bedrock centering), place the tooltip in the corner that obstructs the mouse the least. Best combined with screen-width wrapping.
yacl3.config.adaptivetooltips:config.alw: Always align to corners, even when it is not needed.
yacl3.config.adaptivetooltips:config.pre: Since 1.19.3, Minecraft prevents tooltips from going off the left edge by clamping their x position to 4. This can make tooltips overlap the hovered element and break Adaptive Tooltips' positioning.
yacl3.config.adaptivetooltips:config.onl: Minecraft has hover tooltips (following the mouse) and focused/menu tooltips (above or below a button). When enabled, only hover tooltips are repositioned and scrolled; menu and modded positioners are left alone. Disable this if you want scrolling and centering to apply to config-screen/menu tooltips too.
yacl3.config.adaptivetooltips:config.use: Use YetAnotherConfigLib's positioning for all GUI button widgets (the same style as the tooltip you are reading now).
adaptivetooltips.label.scrolling_instruc: While a tooltip is showing, hold %s and scroll to move it vertically. Hold %s as well to scroll horizontally. (Hover tooltips only.)
yacl3.config.adaptivetooltips:config.smo: Tooltip scrolling appears smooth instead of instant.
yacl3.config.adaptivetooltips:config.scr: Which direction tooltip scrolling goes in.
yacl3.config.adaptivetooltips:config.ver: Pixels to move the tooltip vertically per scroll step.
yacl3.config.adaptivetooltips:config.hor: Pixels to move the tooltip horizontally per scroll step.
yacl3.config.adaptivetooltips:config.scr: Hold this key while scrolling to move the tooltip vertically.
yacl3.config.adaptivetooltips:config.hor: Hold this key as well while scrolling to move the tooltip horizontally.
yacl3.config.adaptivetooltips:config.cat: Options that modify how tooltips look.
yacl3.config.adaptivetooltips:config.too: Modifies the transparency of tooltips by a percentage.
yacl3.config.adaptivetooltips:config.rem: Removes the extra 2 pixels of line padding from the first line of the tooltip.
adaptivetooltips.wrap_text_behaviour.scr: Wraps tooltips based on the screen width. Designed to be paired with Bedrock Centering.
adaptivetooltips.wrap_text_behaviour.rem: Wraps tooltips based on the space left until the edge of the screen.
Only works with hover tooltip positioners. See the description of Only Reposition Hover Tooltips.
adaptivetooltips.wrap_text_behaviour.hal: Wraps tooltips to at most half of the screen width.
adaptivetooltips.wrap_text_behaviour.sma: Wraps lines that are considerably longer than the others, with a hard limit of 3/4 of the screen width.
